handle: Catalytic Cys450 (triad Cys450/His862/Asp895) — the same active-site nucleophile
thesis: 2025-26 surge across gastric (Cell Death & Dis 2025), colorectal ID3/immune escape (Adv Sci 2026), HCC/prostate/ovarian/lung — yet no dedicated USP35 probe, program, or patent has surfaced and only ~6 of ~100 DUBs have quality inhibitors, leaving the active-site covalent lane genuinely open.

validation: Paralog-selective substrate-pocket cysteine enabling washout-resistant transport blockade; transporter biology of interest in oncology/immunometabolism.
thesis: Washout-resistant covalent block of a paralog-selective quasi-catalytic cysteine the reversible transporter field cannot durably engage.
top_risk: No validated human proof-of-concept for the target (the MEDI7247 ADC failed), so target validation is the binding constraint.

validation: Receptor pharmacologically validated (seladelpar approval 2024); a proven covalent playbook exists to port (Flare FX-909 covalent inverse-agonist on the PPARG-Cys313 analog).
thesis: Port the de-risked Flare PPARG covalent inverse-agonist chemistry onto the homologous PPARD Cys249 for an oncology indication.
top_risk: Pharmacology is opposite (agonist validation vs. needed inverse-agonism) and the PPARD oncology thesis itself is unproven.

handle: ligandable C303/C322 (regulatory, not active-site; the 'Cys424 active-site' claim is FALSE)
validation: Validated immunology target (PKC-theta); covalent lane open after reversible EXS4318 dropped by BMS Oct-2025; CysDB-ligandable cysteines exist.
thesis: Open covalent lane on a validated T-cell immunology target whose lead reversible competitor was just discontinued.
top_risk: The only ligandable cysteines are regulatory not active-site and no productive covalent cysteine is confirmed, so engagement may not be functional.

handle: hinge C424 (= BRAF C532 conserved hinge cysteine)
validation: RAF pathway A-grade validated; NO covalent RAF inhibitor in clinic; covalent pan-RAF answers V600E negative-allostery and dimer-escape that reversible agents cannot.
thesis: First covalent pan-RAF on the conserved hinge Cys, locking out dimer/paradox escape that reversible RAF inhibitors leave open.
top_risk: Directed engagement of C424 is computational-only (unproven), and the conserved hinge Cys imposes a wild-type pan-RAF tox ceiling.

handle: linker C194 (ligandable across 4 datasets; silent for direct inhibition)
validation: Undrugged myeloma Achilles-heel transcription factor; C194 ligandable in 4 chemoproteomic datasets; no covalent program (vs dIRF4-2 PROTAC + Ionis ASO).
thesis: Enter the undrugged MM TF as a covalent degrader off the ligandable but silent C194, claiming clean covalent white space.
top_risk: C194 is functionally silent for direct inhibition, forcing a degrader bet with no covalent proof-of-concept against an entrenched PROTAC/ASO field.

handle: P-loop C287 (C277 numbering) in the ATP pocket
validation: Doubly validated P-loop cysteine; YES1-amplified NSCLC/SCLC/TNBC genetics; rare kinome P-loop Cys (~1.4% of kinome).
thesis: Durable covalent P-loop occupancy in YES1-amplified tumors where a rare, structurally addressable cysteine gives a real chemical foothold.
top_risk: C287 is shared with SRC/FGR so the warhead gives no intra-SFK selectivity, and reversible NXP900 is already in Ph1b in the lead indication.

validation: Genuine nucleophilic active-site cysteine; aldose-reductase biology long pursued; covalent durability could exceed reversible ARIs.
thesis: Covalent active-site occupancy of Cys298 to convert transient aldose-reductase inhibition into durable, washout-resistant blockade.
top_risk: Historical ARI failures were efficacy/translation, not potency, so covalency may improve the wrong axis and not rescue the indication.

handle: putative gamma-unique cysteine (unconfirmed) to break the PKC conserved-ATP-pocket problem
validation: A gamma-unique cysteine could solve the PKC selectivity problem; orphan CNS indication (SCA14) gives a clean genetic rationale.
thesis: Exploit a PKC-gamma-unique cysteine to deliver the isoform selectivity the conserved ATP pocket has always denied, in orphan CNS.
top_risk: The gamma-unique ligandable cysteine is unconfirmed, so the entire selectivity thesis rests on an unverified structural premise.
